source_inventory.description: Bounded support policy reference for refunds, escalations, account access, and evidence-required replies.
Structured ticket categories and priority rules used by support operations.
Manual rubric for concise, evidence-backed, non-hallucinated support triage answers.
extraction_fields: must avoid refund or legal promises without policy evidence

user_need_inputs: triage incoming support tickets by category and priority
draft a concise customer-facing response with evidence refs
escalate when policy or customer facts are missing
forbidden_data_handling: Do not store credentials, customer secrets, raw ticket transcripts, or full tool result bodies in managed AgentMo evidence.
Do not promise refunds, legal outcomes, or account access without policy evidence and escalation rules.
Do not treat declared smoke evidence as production support certification.
